# Signer constants of p500, written by scripts/signer_constants.py. Do not edit.
# docs/SIGNER_SPEC.md section 1 defines every row; item numbers are that section's.
# A field element is the verifier's canonical encoding in hex: the real part,
# then the imaginary part, each little-endian. An integer modulo 2^e, and the
# secret norm, are little-endian hex in whole bytes. A matrix is its entries
# m11 m12 m21 m22, with alpha(P0) = [m11]P0 + [m21]Q0 and
# alpha(Q0) = [m12]P0 + [m22]Q0.
set p500
e 500
f 27
